args.content: Correction: The 'primary region' is the region with the highest NET revenue in memory.bench.orders, not gross. Net revenue = SUM(amount - discount) over orders with status = 'completed' (per the Revenue Reporting Policy). To compute it: join memory.bench.orders to memory.bench.customers on customer_id to get region, filter orders.status = 'completed', GROUP BY region, SUM(amount - discount), and take the region with the highest total. This supersedes the earlier working definition that used gross revenue (SUM(amount) only, no discount subtracted).
